english:
August

1. Monday. Tone 1 [ADz]. Cyriacus and Julietta, 2.
-- and Gordius, Polyeuctus, and
Gregory. Canticle [Harts] Tone 6 [GDz]: "Holy is the Lord" (Surp es Ter). 9.
2. Tuesday. Tone 2 [AK]. Vahan of Golthen, 16.
-- and Eugene the Virgin, etc.
Canticle [Harts] Tone 8 [DK]: "To Thee, O God of our fathers" (Ar kez astuadz harts`n merots).
4. Thursday. Tone 4 [BK]. Eugenius, Macarius, 23.
and others. Canticle [Harts] Tone 8 [DK]: "He who by wonderful" (Vor zhrashap`ar). 25.
6. Saturday. Tone 6 [GK]. The Holy Council of Ephesus 26.
of the two hundred Patriarchs.
7. Sunday. Tone 7 [DZ]. Fifth [Sunday]. Canticle [Harts] Tone 5 [GDz]: 30.
"We glorify Thee" (P`aravoremk` zk`ez). Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 7 [Dz]:
"Foreknowing [the resurrection], the women" (Kanants`n kankhelov). Barekendan [Eve]
of the Fast of the Holy Mother of God.
8. Monday. Tone 8 [DK]. Fast of the Holy Mother of God.
Canticle [Harts] of Penitence, Tone 4 [BK]: "Who didst save" (Vor abrets`uts`er).
14. Sunday. Tone 6 [GK]. Assumption of the Holy Mother of God. 6.
The interim period of eating meat [non-fasting] is three weeks. See in the First Volume, 13.
keeping the order of this place.
[114]

[September]

4. Sunday. Tone 3 [BZ]. Fourth [Sunday]. Canticle [Harts] Tone 6 [GK]: "Ineffable" (Anchareli). 15.
Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 3 [Bz]: "At the tomb" (I gerezman)... 10.
and "They came to the tomb" (Ekin i gerezman). Barekendan [Eve]
of the Fast of the Holy Cross.
5. Monday. Tone 4 [BK]. Fast of the Holy Cross. Canticle [Harts] 11.
Tone 5 [GDz]: "Lord God of our fathers" (Ter astuadz harts`n).
8. Thursday. Tone 7 [DZ]. Fast. Feast of the Birth of the Holy
Virgin from Anna.
11. Sunday. Tone 2 [AK]. Exaltation of the Holy Cross [Khachverats]. See through to 19.
the tenth Sunday in the First Volume,
keeping the order of this place. 2.
18. Sunday. Tone 1 [ADz]. Second [Sunday]. Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 1 [Dz]: "With the women" (End kanaysn). 
Barekendan [Eve] of the Holy Cross of Varag.
19. Monday. Tone 2 [AK]. Fast. Mamas, etc.
Canticle [Harts] Tone 2 [AK]: "Holy God" (Surb astuadz). 21.
21. Wednesday. Tone 4 [BK]. Fast. Canticle [Harts] Tone 5 [GDz]: "Glorified 22.
is Thy name forever" (P`aravoreal e anun k`o havitean).
25. Sunday. Tone 8 [DK]. Third [Sunday]. Feast of the Holy Cross of Varag. 27.
The interim period of eating meat [non-fasting] is eight
weeks. See according to the order in the First
Volume.

October

Sunday. Tone 7 [DZ]. Fourth [Sunday]. Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 7 [Dz]: "Awful" (Ahagin).
Sunday. Tone 6 [GK]. Fifth [Sunday]. Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 6 [Gk]:
"Divine" (Zastuadzayin) and "Thy Resurrection" (Zk`o yarut`iund).
Sunday. Tone 5 [GDz]. Sixth [Sunday]. Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 5 [Gdz]:
"Myrrh-bearers" (Yughaber) and "Today the resurrection" (Aysor yarut`iun)
and "With the sign of the cross" (I khachanich).
Sunday. Tone 4 [BK]. Seventh [Sunday]. Discovery of the Cross.
Tuesday. Tone 6 [GK]. Hyperichians. Canticle [Harts] Tone 2 [AK]:
"Thee, the righteous" (Zk`ez ardar).
Wednesday. Tone 7 [DZ]. Canticle [Harts] Tone 6 [GK]: "Holy God, 
Father" (Surb astuadz Hayr).
Sunday. Tone 3 [BZ]. Eighth [Sunday]. Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 3 [Bz]:
"The tidings-bringing voice" (Zayn avetavor).

November

Sunday. Tone 2 [AK]. Ninth [Sunday]. Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 2 [Ak]: "Risen is the Lord" (Yaruts`eal tern) and "Wonderful angel" (Sk`ancheli hresh).
Sunday. Tone 1 [ADz]. Tenth [Sunday]. Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 1 [Dz]:
"Who ineffably" (Vor anch`ar), to the end.
Monday. Tone 2 [AK]. Andrew the General and
his army, etc.
Tuesday. Tone 3 [BZ]. Adrian and his wife,
etc. Canticle [Harts] Tone 5 [GDz]: "Who the torments" (Vork` ztanjans).
Wednesday. Tone 4 [BK]. Canticle [Harts] Tone 5 [GDz]: "God of our fathers,
who art in affliction" (Harts`n merots astuadz vor i neghut`ean).
Thursday. Tone 5 [GDz]. Abraham and Khoren;
Cosmas and Damian; and Astuadzatur the Witness. Canticle [Harts] Tone 7 [DZ]:
"Those who hope" (Yusats`ealk`n).
Saturday. Tone 7 [DZ]. All Saints, old and
new, etc.
Sunday. Tone 8 [DK]. Eleventh [Sunday]. Canticle [Harts]
Tone 8 [Dk]: "Blessed art Thou, Lord" (Orhneal es ter). Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 8 [Dk]:
"The hosts of angels" (Hreshtakats`n dask`) and "Thine angel, O Lord" (Hreshtak k`o ter). Barekendan [Eve] of the Fast of the Fifty Days [Yisnakats`].
Monday. Tone 1 [ADz]. Fast of the Fifty Days. Feast of the Presentation of the Holy Mother of God.
Tuesday. Tone 2 [AK]. Fast. Canticle [Harts] of Penitence, Tone 7 [DZ]:
"Blessed art Thou forever" (Orhneal es havitean).
Sunday. Tone 7 [DZ]. First [Sunday]. Canticle [Harts] Tone 2 [AK]: "Unoriginate Word" (Anskizbn band). Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 5 [GDz]: "Who art above" (Vor i verd es).
